## Identity

- Full Name: Junaid Akram, PhD
- Role: Assistant Professor & HEC-approved PhD Supervisor
- Lab: Software Security Assessment Lab (SSA Lab)
- Institution: COMSATS University Islamabad, Lahore Campus
- Email: junaidakram@cuilahore.edu.pk
- Lab Email: ssa.laab@gmail.com

## Academic Background

- PhD in Software Engineering — Tsinghua University (2015–2020)
- MPhil — Zhejiang University of Technology (2012–2015)
- Postdoctoral Research — SnT, University of Luxembourg (2021–2023)
- Assistant Professor — Xiamen University Malaysia (2020–2021)
- Assistant Professor — COMSATS University Islamabad, Lahore Campus (2023–present)

## Research Areas

Dr. Junaid Akram works on source-code security assessment, software vulnerability detection, code clone analysis, Android and cross-architecture malware detection, software testing, automated test-data generation, software evolution, maintenance, and reuse.
